name: Doro Wat
description: Slow-cooked chicken in a rich berbere sauce, with a boiled egg and soft, tangy injera. A little taste of home in every bite.

name: Tibs
description: Tender beef sautéed with onions, peppers and fragrant Ethiopian spices. Served sizzling with freshly made injera.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: A golden, oven-baked crust with bright tomato sauce, melting mozzarella and fresh basil. Simple ingredients, beautifully done.

name: Cheese Burger
description: A juicy grilled beef patty, melted cheese, crisp lettuce and our house sauce, tucked into a toasted sesame bun.

name: Fresh Juice
description: Freshly squeezed orange juice. Bright, refreshing and made to order, with no added sugar.
